'''Jordel Tlan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a high-ranking officer in [[Synchet Industries]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. However, the corporation was shut down around [[3648 BBY]]. Possessing considerable wealth, he became reclusive and settled down in [[Star Cluster Casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], tended only by droids and a single aide [[Netula Pahn]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was visited by [[Cipher Nine]] regarding information about the Synchet.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jordel Tlan is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Kiff VandenHeuvel]].<ref name="TOR" />
